summary: Build-3 is in: the page for scouts, the view data, play-scout.mjs, the engine docs, and the archive of scout/. web/src/lib.rs `view()` adds top-level `revealed` (the led civ's revealed tiles, empty at the pick) and `trail_work` (`[tile, labour, need]` for each trail under way); a scout row with a route carries `plan` = `{known, possible, candidates}`, where known and possible are `{path, cost}` from the route's start (null when there is none). www/select.js: a scout's panel shows its people, pack, food, route, known and possible costs and last outcome, with buttons 'Start here' and 'Route to here' (they arm a map click, the second sends setRoute from the picked start or the scout's tile) and 'Clear route'. www/main.js: body.dataset gains `scout` (the led civ's scout id), `routeState` (`none`, `set`, `found`, `nopath`; found/nopath are the last scout route outcome from events, cleared by a new route) and `armed` (`start`, `to`, or empty); a right-click with a scout selected sends nothing. www/map-view.js: revealed tiles get a faint ring, trails under way a partial line, and `setPlan` draws the known route solid and the possible route dashed over it. Feed: the scout's event kinds have icons and filters. www/check.mjs checks the new data and drives the scout's route orders (set, clear, refusals). www/play-scout.mjs (`node www/play-scout.mjs [out-dir]`, default relay/specs/28/screens) leads the first civ on seed 2, small, selects the scout at the capital, picks start (capital) and end (tile 58) by clicks, ends turns until routeState is found or nopath, and exits non-zero if it is not found or the page errors. Run result: the route is set (known 11, possible 7, 7 steps), found after two end turns, with one trail built by the scout (tile 144). Screenshots: relay/specs/28/screens/route-both.png (both routes) and trail-built.png. engine/CLAUDE.md has the new command, layout rows and body.dataset fields. scout/ is deleted except a README.md pointing at tag prototype/scout (it exists, at 46d2401), and `scout` is dropped from ci.yml's js matrix. engine/check.sh passes end to end (fmt, clippy, all tests, wasm and native digests, check.mjs); the engine's rules are unchanged this step.

decisions.decision: routeState is the led civ's scout state: 'set' while it has a route, else the last route outcome ('found' or 'nopath'), else 'none'. Found and nopath come from scoutRouteFound and scoutNoRoute events for the player's civ and clear when a route is set or cleared.
decisions.why: The brief names routeState without values; the scout clears its route when it finishes, so the page has to remember how it ended for a script to wait on it.

decisions.decision: Start and end are armed map clicks: 'Start here' arms a click that records the start (it does not send anything); 'Route to here' arms a click that sends setRoute from that start, or the scout's tile when none was picked. Picking another selection forgets the start; the same scout keeps it.
decisions.why: Matches the brief's wording (each arms a map click; the second sends SetRoute, with from defaulting to the scout's tile).

decisions.decision: The possible route is drawn dashed over the known route, and the known route is drawn solid under it.
decisions.why: In the page's own example both paths are the same tiles (the cost differs, not the path), so the dashes over the solid line are what show both.

decisions.decision: play-scout.mjs targets tile 58 from the capital (166) on seed 2, small, the tile build-2's lead orders use, and it screenshots the route centred on its middle at minK 14.
decisions.why: The brief asks for the route build-2's lead_orders uses; a full-map frame made the route unreadable at screenshot size.

decisions.decision: The trail-built screenshot is taken at the first end turn in which a tile of the route that had no trail gains one, and the separate route-found frame is not kept.
decisions.why: In this game the scout's trail completes on the turn the route is found, so a route-found frame would duplicate it.

ideas.title: The page's example route is mostly trailed already
ideas.body: On seed 2 (small) the capital-to-tile-58 route runs over clan trails on five of its seven tiles; only one tile (144) is left for the scout to build, so the route is found in two turns. A demo route through untrailed country would show the scout's search and trail building better. The owner may want play-scout.mjs to pick a farther target, or a second scenario.

ideas.title: A scout's pack is nearly empty after its route
ideas.body: In the screenshot the scout holds 0.25 of 10 in its pack (0.13 turns of food) two turns after it set out, with no hunger yet. A scout with no route walks home and sits, so it stays fed from the line, but the early pack looks thin. Worth checking the pack's size (SCOUT.pack) against the store after founding.
